::: {#exm-logits}

#### Shifting the logits

```{python}
#| code-fold: show
logits = mlp(x_test[:1])
shifted = logits + 5
softmax_gap = (torch.softmax(shifted, dim=1) - torch.softmax(logits, dim=1)).abs().max().item()
print(logits.detach().numpy().round(3))
print(softmax_gap)
```

The [logits](#def-logits) of the first test image are the 10 numbers printed.
Adding 5 to each changes the softmax probabilities by at most `r format(py$softmax_gap, digits = 2)`, a rounding error.

:::
